authority: none: internal simulation book; the LLM has no authority over real capital and none over order sending; nothing here calls a broker

candidate_set.added_by_source: the CH-14a `added_by_source` block, included iff FUNNEL_NEWS_SOURCE_ENABLED
candidate_set.source: opportunity funnel final list (IC_FUNNEL_PATH `candidates`, ranker order)

claims: none: a PRODUCT_EXPERIMENT; no skill claim from this book's results
costs: llm_portfolio.grade charges xs_ranker.round_trip_bps by liquidity band on entry
fill: llm_portfolio.entry_session: first session strictly after the decision date, at the open
name: llm_selector_v0
objective: terminal wealth over hold_sessions under the BALANCED personality, read as excess over (i) the selection twin and (ii) the incumbent; the CH-11 ruler (band twins, rank p with Holm, block t at every origin) grades the book

packet.admission: a fact is admitted iff its stamp is strictly before the decision time; a fact without a parseable stamp refuses the packet

fields.digest.theme: world-digest themes naming the ticker (discovery_autopsy.digest_names), stamped by the digest file
fields.funnel.*: the candidate's own funnel fields, stamped at the funnel's generated_at
fields.knowable.item: news/filing corpus rows naming the ticker (discovery_autopsy.Corpus), stamped by known_at
fields.language: digest themes and corpus titles above llm_language.NON_LATIN_BAR non-Latin script are left out
fields.price.close/ret_5d/ret_21d/ret_63d/vol_6: daily bars dated before the decision, each bar stamped 21:00 UTC of its date
fields.revisions.revisions_Nd/net_raises_Nd/med: analyst/target_revisions.parquet rows with event_date before the decision (date-only = end of day)
fields.source.added_by: the CH-14a news/filing source that added the name (added_by_source block only)

prompts.system: You are the selector of an internal SIMULATED paper book. You have no authority over money and no orders are sent. You will be given a list of candidate US stocks and, for each, a packet of facts. Every fact carries the time it became knowable; nothing after the decision time is included. Use ONLY the facts given; do not use anything you remember about these companies after the decision time, and do not invent prices, targets or events. Choose exactly {k} names from the candidate list for a holding period of {hold} trading sessions, equal weight, entered at the next session's open, and charged the round-trip cost shown per name. Your book will be compared against {k} names drawn at random from the same list and against the first {k} names of the ranker's own order. Answer with JSON only, no prose before or after.

reply_rule: exactly k picks, each ticker in the candidate set, no duplicate, an allowed direction and a non-empty reason; any defect refuses the WHOLE decision, the reply is kept on the refusal row and counted; never repaired

twins.incumbent: the ranker's own top-k: the first k names of the funnel candidate list
twins.selection: k names drawn without replacement from the same candidate set by np.random.default_rng(seed), seed = LLM_SELECTOR_SEED_BASE + the decision date's ordinal; seed and draw recorded

weights: equal weight over the k picks, fully invested, CASH 0 declared
